data.source_title: Improving Emergency Department radiology transportation time: a successful implementation of lean methodology
data.locator: Methods, study design (period dates); Methods, theoretical model step 2 and sampling (endpoint, inclusion/exclusion); Results, Table 2 (mean, SD and <=10-minute share).
data.source_setting: Emergency department of American University of Beirut Medical Center, largest tertiary-care center in Lebanon; all ED plain radiographs meeting study sampling criteria.
data.source_period: Pre-intervention: 2012-10-17 to 2013-04-17; post-intervention: 2013-05-19 to 2013-11-19; one-month washout. Excludes radiographs 00:00-08:00, and cases leaving against medical advice or transferred to another hospital.
data.source_n: 6,186 radiographs pre-intervention; 4,879 post-intervention, after stated exclusions.
data.quantity: Cashier order-processed to radiographer study-initiation transportation TAT (pre/post intervention)
data.unit: minutes from cashier order processing to radiographer study initiation; percent of radiographs with this interval <=10 minutes
data.source_evidence_basis: Primary retrospective before/after operational cohort reports means, standard deviations, and an empirical threshold share for 11,065 radiographs. Methods define the measured transport TAT as cashier order processing to PACS-recorded radiographer study initiation. The Discussion later calls it an order-processing-to-study-completion step, which conflicts with the explicit Methods definition; this record follows Methods.
data.limitations: Single center, plain radiography only, nonrandomized intervention with concurrent ED workflow changes; excludes overnight radiographs and AMA/transfer cases. Mean/SD do not define the full empirical distribution. The paper's Discussion uses a conflicting endpoint description; use the Methods endpoint above.
data.inferred_scenario_use: External reference for cashier-processed order to imaging study initiation elapsed time, preserving the before/after context and exclusions; do not use as RWJ timing or as imaging processing/read duration.
